comment: Link text “Click here” does not identify its purpose, and the surrounding text does not distinguish it from the second “Click here” link. Fails 2.4.4 (F63: link context only in content not related to the link).
Link text “Click here” (after “Onions.”) does not identify its purpose, and the surrounding text does not distinguish it from the other “Click here” link. Fails 2.4.4 (F63).
“Link text “Click here” (after “Killer bees.”) does not identify its purpose, and the surrounding text does not distinguish it from the other “Click here” link. Fails 2.4.4 (F63).”
Image has no alt attribute, so assistive technology gets no text alternative. Fails 1.1.1 (F65).
"Free Penguins" text contrast is 3.88:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum. Fails 1.4.3.
Nav link calls blur() on focus, so keyboard users can't reach or activate it. Fails 2.1.1 (F55).
No skip link, no headings and no landmarks: no way to bypass the repeated navigation. Fails 2.4.1.
blur() on focus removes focus, so no focus indicator is ever visible. Fails 2.4.7 (F55).
The html element has no lang attribute. Fails 3.1.1.
Receiving focus triggers blur(), a change of context on focus. Fails 3.2.1 (F55).
Choosing an option in QUICKMENU navigates immediately, with no submit button. Fails 3.2.2 (F37).
The QUICKMENU select has no label or instructions. Fails 3.3.2.
The validator finds 7 parse errors in the page source. Fails 4.1.1 (F70).
The QUICKMENU select has no accessible name. Fails 4.1.2.
